files.full_content:
-- R-201 通報明細視圖
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_r201_detail AS
SELECT *
FROM transactions t
WHERE t.tx_type = 'WITHDRAW'
  AND t.tx_time >= :start_date AND t.tx_time < :end_date;

_golden.intent: R002:視圖使用 SELECT * → minor(欄位異動時下游會靜默受影響)
